name: Year Up United Bay Area
description: Tuition-free job training, paid stipend, internship opportunities, and career placement for ages 18-29
fullDescription: Year Up United (formerly Year Up) provides young adults ages 18-29 with tuition-free job training, internship opportunities with corporate partners, and job placement support to launch careers in fields like IT, banking, and data analytics.
whatTheyOffer:
- Tuition-free professional and technical skills training (hybrid virtual and in-person)
- Internship opportunities with corporate partners
- Educational stipend paid every two weeks, increasing during the internship
- Career coaching and job placement support
- Professional mentor, alumni network, and ongoing support
- Bay Area training in IT support, application development, data analytics, banking, project management, network security, and more
howToGetIt:
1. Must be 18-29 years old
2. High school diploma or GED required
3. Must not have a bachelor's degree
4. Low to moderate income
5. Must be authorized to work in U.S. and live within commuting distance of a Year Up United location
6. Apply online and complete admissions steps (assessment, documents, background check)
keywords: Year Up, Year Up United, young adults, career training, tech jobs, internship, professional skills, 18-29, IT, software, help desk, corporate internship, Oakland, San Jose
